# Workflow Station Guidelines

Human-facing designer, Admin, and Portal guidelines. No login.
Canonical site: /help/ (edge: http://localhost:3000/help/).

Do not invent UI labels. Ground answers in these articles and the screenshots under /help/guides/.

## Index by job

- /help/computed-fields — Computed field formulas (Table Design; Admin Relation Tables #relation)
- /help/table-design — Tables, fields, PK and FK (Function Unit Table Design; formulas stay on /help/computed-fields)
- /help/view-design — View Design lists and Access control (Business Units + Roles; empty = System Administrator only; #access)
- /help/fu-documents — Requirements and Function Unit Design documents (Function Unit Settings; Edit / Preview / Import .md .markdown .txt up to 200 KB / Download / Version History / Save; import only loads the editor until Save; versions vMajor.Minor with source labels; Compare with current, Restore; documents travel with Export, Clone and Version Management rollback; #editor #import #history #travel)
- /help/ai-studio — Build with AI dialog and AI Studio entry (Start a new AI design, Continue AI draft, One-click generate #one-click: requirements box up to 4000 characters, optional when a Requirements document exists; Replace the current design? confirmation every time; writes process, tables, forms, actions, decisions; not views, connections, email templates, email monitors, automation bindings; result card Applied / Apply / Let AI fix it #result; no Undo, roll back in Version Management)
- /help/email-send — Send email (Connections #connection, Email Templates #template, Send Task #send-task; field catalog for every control)
- /help/email-monitor — Email Monitor (inbound connection, monitor template, extraction wizard, attachments → FILE #extract-attachments, original email .eml → FILE #extract-raw-eml, Start Event #start-event; field catalog for every control)
- /help/up-tasks-to-claim — To Do: Current Assignee column; claim pool on the same list; Claim all; selection-bar Claim/Unclaim; Unclaim all (own holds); auto-claim on open (default off); Leader / Approver / SYS_ADMIN force unclaim and reassign
- /help/task-delegate — Delegate a task (User Portal To Do; specified user lookup or BU+Role; does not change Current Assignee)
- /help/up-delegations — Delegations standing rules (Setup → Delegations; Specified user or Specified BU and Role; All / Partial / Temporary; default To Do does not merge overlay; Delegated tab = To Do Delegated filter)
- /help/form-upload — Form Design Advanced Upload in Extend (Multi switch defaults to Single / one file URL; turn on Multi to set Max files, default 10; Max file size default 10MB, platform cap 50MB; Can not download hides Download in the File details drawer; Preview stays available; File Description saves only when you click Save; Callback URL and Auto Send to FileNet are hidden for now; Advance stores FileNet mapping; runtime cards inside the drop zone open a details drawer; list cells show firstName +N). Basic Upload uses the same drawer (/help/form-ctl-upload). Bind the widget Field to a Table Design FILE column (Import Table Fields, or type the column name). Dragging from Extend does not add a table column. Each scene is its own canvas: on My Request / Assign Task use Add Advanced Upload from New Request so the same Field is reused, then Save.
- /help/form-events — How to write events (when each Create event runs; control Edit + Form event: parameters, values, required, lock, show/hide, options, errors, banners, lookup filter, focus, labels, hooks, user). setValue argument shape is on each control’s Events; #set-shapes is an index.
- /help/form-events-basic — Basic palette index (each control is its own article)
- /help/form-ctl-input — Input (Field, Type, Sensitive Mask; Title on help_pr)
- /help/form-ctl-textarea — Textarea (Rows, autosize, word count)
- /help/form-ctl-password — Password (masked text; do not copy the value)
- /help/form-ctl-input-number — InputNumber (min, max, precision, step; quantity)
- /help/form-ctl-radio — Radio (all options visible; pick exactly one; stores value key)
- /help/form-ctl-checkbox — Checkbox (zero or more; Options)
- /help/form-ctl-select — Select (dropdown; Default Value; Scenario on help_pr)
- /help/form-ctl-switch — Switch (active/inactive value)
- /help/form-ctl-slider — Slider (Hermes Min, Max, Step)
- /help/form-ctl-rate — Rate (stars)
- /help/form-ctl-date — Date (Start date vs Need-by)
- /help/form-ctl-date-range — DateRange
- /help/form-ctl-time — Time
- /help/form-ctl-time-range — TimeRange
- /help/form-ctl-cascader — Cascader (Hermes Placeholder)
- /help/form-ctl-color-picker — ColorPicker
- /help/form-ctl-upload — Upload (stock Basic; Advanced Upload is /help/form-upload)
- /help/form-ctl-tree — Tree
- /help/form-ctl-tree-select — TreeSelect
- /help/form-ctl-transfer — Transfer (Hermes Left Title / Right Title)
- /help/form-ctl-editor — Editor (Hermes Rows, Placeholder, Max Length)
- /help/form-ctl-sub-table — Sub-Table (bound SUB grid; help_pr_line; Allow Add/Edit/Delete; List View)
- /help/form-ctl-lookup — Lookup (Relation Table, Search / Display fields, Fixed Filters, cascade, Backfill; setLookupFilter)
- /help/form-events-extend — Extend and MI event index (Inline Form, Link Form, Owner, Record Note, Assignment Mode). Sub-Table and Lookup have their own articles.
- /help/form-events-layout — Layout and Auxiliary control events (click, Tabs extras)
